name: bankstatemently
description: Convert your bank statements into structured, queryable financial data — transactions, accounts, and balances from any PDF statement, then analyze them across every statement you've uploaded.

interface.shortDescription: Convert PDF bank statements into structured data.
interface.longDescription:
Convert your bank statements into structured, queryable financial data — transactions, accounts, and balances from any PDF statement, then analyze them across every statement you've uploaded.

Leave the API key blank to sign in with your browser on first use, or paste a bsk_live_ key for headless setups.

Tools: convert_statement, request_upload, get_statement, categorize_statement, list_statements, get_credits, rate_statement, list_transactions, aggregate, group_by, top_n, compare, time_series, list_transfers, evaluate_benchmark.
